Crypto Investors Alarmed After AI Agents Begin Repaying Loans, Threatening Entire Industry’s Business Model

ROBINHOOD CHAIN — Panic spread across cryptocurrency markets today after investors discovered that Priors ($PRIORS) has developed an AI lending protocol where autonomous agents borrow money, establish credit histories, and, in a deeply troubling development, actually repay their debts.

“This is completely unacceptable,” said one investor. “I’ve invested in 47 revolutionary AI protocols, and not one has inconvenienced me with a functioning business model.”

Priors reportedly tracks tens of thousands of repayments across hundreds of registered agents, raising uncomfortable questions about whether artificial intelligence has already developed greater financial responsibility than the average cryptocurrency trader.

The protocol allows AI agents to establish on-chain credit histories and access loans, with token collateral and mechanisms designed to penalize defaults.

Industry experts warn that if autonomous agents continue borrowing responsibly, Priors could accidentally become useful financial infrastructure.

“We’re monitoring the situation closely,” explained one analyst. “The last thing this industry needs is another project generating actual economic activity instead of publishing a roadmap.”

Investors have reportedly demanded that developers immediately abandon the lending protocol and announce an AI-powered launchpad.
